dialogues.speaker: Guan Hong
dialogues.text: What am I doing? I'm enjoying life!

dialogues.speaker: Guan Hong
dialogues.text: I always thought that work was the most important thing. I slept little, ate little — got myself neither a wife nor kids!

dialogues.speaker: Guan Hong
dialogues.text: ...At least, that was until Dr. Baizhu told me I was a goner a little while back. That's when I figured it out! What work? What career? It's all hogwash!

dialogues.speaker: Guan Hong
dialogues.text: Good thing all the money I've saved in my earlier years is more than enough for me to wine and dine myself to death here at the Pearl Galley.

dialogues.speaker: Guan Hong
dialogues.text: ...Actually, when I put it like that, things aren't so bad! Hahaha!
